clips.title: Ordering Lunch at Saizeriya

clips.title: Strolling Around Shinsekai Challenge
grammar: 〜しかない — have no choice but to

lines.ja: やばい。
lines.en: Oh man.
lines.speaker: Yuto

lines.ja: クソ暑いけどやるしかない。
lines.en: It's ridiculously hot, but I have no choice.
lines.speaker: Yuto

lines.en: This started out of the blue.
